nodes.label: Search UI Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Centred single-column layout on a pale blue gradient. Top to bottom: title and tagline, a card holding the Demo/NFCorpus dataset toggle with its description line, the query input, a 'Generate answer' checkbox with the EN/DE toggle, and a right-aligned Search button. Below the card, the RAG answer sits in a tinted panel labelled ANSWER, followed by white result cards each showing a document title with its RRF score and body text. Demonstrates that the answer is visually separated from the ranked hits that grounded it.
